newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Mostly easier European feeds start slow on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mostly easier European feeds start slow on dollar.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started slow this morning with sellers offering South American soymeal between $2 up for nearby material to $2 lower for more distant positions following last night's Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were offered unchanged to $2 lower on the back of a stronger dollar. No trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.

"I don't believe operators were cautious because it is Fryday the 13th. The high dollar seems to be the main reason to keep the market calm ahead of the weekend," one broker said. --KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
